ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (lobe interiors) to low-intensity black pixels (central peduncle, median notch region, and entire trailing edge perimeter).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous white ellipsoidal blobs occupying approximately 80% of the interior surface of each lobe; dark pigmentation (Value < 30) concentrated at the central axis and forming a jagged 10-40 pixel wide border along the trailing edge; distinct high-contrast dark circular spots located in the distal upper quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 52 degrees; the vertex of the notch extends 15% into the vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrated boundary with irregular peaks (1-8 pixel amplitude); a prominent macro-indentation (secondary notch) located on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately 20% distance from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins follow a smooth convex curve from the peduncle base to the tips; trailing edges follow a generally horizontal but highly irregular linear path.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity (white) circular pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization; scattered individual white circular points on the interior of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, non-aligned linear streaks (rake marks) present on the lower-left interior lobe and mid-right lobe interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe; dense calcareous clusters (barnacles) at both distal fluke extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: A vertical pair of distinct dark elliptical spots positioned in the distal-lateral region of the right lobe.
